# EmptyState
Atlas EmptyState v1 — centred stack of an icon, title, description and actions that tells the user why a list or screen has no content and what to do next. 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), no variant for the case, no surface of its own.

USE WHEN
· A list, table or screen has no items to show and the user can act: create the first one, or change what they searched for.
· The first-use, no-results and cleared cases each need their own wording and action.
· The message should be announced politely when a list becomes empty.
DON'T USE WHEN
· Content failed to load → Alert with a Retry action (Error recovery pattern).
· Content is still loading → Skeleton or Spinner.
· A short confirmation of a completed action ("Saved") → Toast.
· The message would sit inside a Card → place it in the page container instead.
HOW TO USE
· Name the cause in `title` as a statement ("No projects yet", "No results for “alpha”") and add one line in `description`.
· Pass a decorative lucide `icon`; the component sizes it and hides it from assistive tech.
· Give exactly one primary `action` (Button primary for first use, outline for no results or undo); add `secondaryAction` only for a help link or ghost Button. In Figma turn on Secondary to show it.
· Default size is md; use sm inside a small panel and lg for a full page.
DO
· Keep it in the same container the list would occupy so the page does not jump.
· Keep the search field visible in the no-results case.
DON'T
· Offer "Create" as the main action of a no-results state.
· Show it for an error or while loading.
RELATED
· Alert — a failed request, not an empty one.
· Skeleton — loading, shown first so the empty state never flashes.

PROPERTIES
Size: sm | md | lg. Icon: instance swap. Title and Description: text. Action: instance swap (Button). Secondary: boolean (default off). Secondary action: instance swap (Button).
